title: Play
text:
Our weekly sessions are designed to be inclusive of everyone, whether playing leisurely or competitively. Our coach is available to provide advice.
We normally play on a Friday evenings from 5.30pm until 6.45pm (September to April) or from 6pm until 7.30pm (May to August). We sometimes break for half term but we play over the summer. There may be other small variations due to the varying availability of the hall. Please see the table below for the detail. Join the club’s WhatsApp group (see the contact us page) for regular reminders and latest updates.
We are open to all adults and motivated, supervised children aged 12 and over. New joiners are welcome to simply turn up at the session of their choice. We can supply all the equipment required, including lending bats. If you have a question before joining, please see the “contact us” page.

title: Membership
text:
We welcome new members at all times. Members are the beating heart of our community and becoming a member is a way of supporting the club.
Members enjoy unlimited access to our weekly Friday sessions for the rest of the membership year. The membership year runs from the 1st of September until the 31st of August each year, regardless of when you become a member. For anyone attending our sessions semi-regularly, it is cheaper to become a member than to pay the £6 on-the-door fee.

title: Recruitment
text:
Coach (Self-Employed) – Junior Table Tennis Sessions
Organisation: Penarth Table Tennis Club
Role: Coach for junior coaching programme
Time commitment: 1.5 hours per week
Pay: £30 per session
Contract type: Self-employed
Application deadline: Sunday 16 August 2026, 5pm
About the role
Penarth Table Tennis Club is seeking a self-employed coach to support the launch of our first junior programme from September 2026. This is an exciting opportunity to shape a new activity from the ground up and to bring your own coaching style, ideas, methods, and personality to the sessions. The role would suit a coach, sports leader, youth worker, school teacher, or anyone with experience working with children and enthusiasm for table tennis.
Sessions will:

run every Friday from 16:15 to 17:15 during term time (excluding school holidays)

take place at St Cyres School in Penarth, CF64 2XP
be open to up to 20 children aged 11 to 18

As a self-employed coach, you will independently plan and deliver sessions using your own professional judgement. The club will not direct how you coach; instead, we will collaborate with you to ensure the sessions meet safeguarding and safety expectations.
You would be expected to:

arrive from 16:00 to set up the room using your preferred layout and coaching approach
deliver engaging, inclusive sessions that help participants develop table tennis skills and confidence
maintain a safe environment throughout and follow agreed safeguarding procedures
remain until 17:30 to conclude the session and support a smooth transition with the next activity (usually the club’s community session, led by a volunteer coach)

The fee for each session is £30 (90 minutes at £20/hour), paid on receipt of an invoice.
Selection criteria
We recognise that excellent coaches come from many backgrounds. If you feel you could be great in this role—even if you do not meet every criterion—we warmly encourage you to apply.
Essential criteria

Ability to independently deliver sport, physical activity, or similar sessions for groups of children aged between 11 and 18.
Ability to create a supportive, engaging, and safe learning environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work positively with the club, players, parents, and the school.
Safeguarding training completed (or willingness to complete before starting).

Valid DBS check (or willingness to obtain one).

First aid qualification (or willingness to obtain one).

Reliable availability on Fridays during term time from 16:00 to 17:30.

Status as a self-employed contractor, responsible for your own tax, insurance, and compliance with all relevant regulations.

The successful candidate will be expected to undergo a DBS check.
Desirable criteria

Level 2 table tennis coaching qualification (or willingness to work towards one).

Ability to play table tennis to a competitive standard.

We also welcome applications from coaches in other sports, youth workers, educators, and anyone with relevant experience working with young people.
Selection process
All candidates should submit the application form by 5pm on Sunday 16 August 2026: Application form
Shortlisted candidates may be invited to:

a brief informal phone conversation

a trial session on Friday 21 August, 18:00–19:30 at St Cyres School (an alternative date can be arranged if a shortlisted candidate is unavailable on 21 August)

Self-employed coaches taking part in the trial session will receive financial compensation. Details will be provided directly to shortlisted candidates.
About the club
Penarth Table Tennis Club is a community club based in Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan. The club is affiliated with Table Tennis Wales, offering opportunities to play leisurely and competitively, and part of the community.
Since being established in March 2025, the club has grown rapidly into a thriving community with a growing membership, eleven tables, and now “Regional Development Club” status with Table Tennis Wales. The club entered two teams into the Cardiff league in October 2025, with one team completing the season unbeaten. The launch of a junior programme represents the next exciting step on the club’s journey.
To find out more, visit the club’s website: www.penarthtabletennis.co.uk
Disclaimer
This recruitment process is part of a wider project to launch a new junior programme. The start date may change depending on factors such as the number of children who register or availability of the venue. The club will keep shortlisted candidates updated, and candidates are welcome to contribute ideas to support the launch.
The junior programme is expected to run initially until December 2026, with the potential to continue into 2027. Subject to the programme’s success, the club would hope to continue working with the successful coach, and applicants who expect to be available beyond December 2026 may be prioritised.
Additional self-employed opportunities may arise, including coaching existing community sessions (Fridays, 17:30–18:45) or representing the club at events. All additional work would be remunerated.
Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion
Penarth Table Tennis Club is committed to equity, diversity, and inclusion across all activities. We aim to create a welcoming, safe, and supportive environment where everyone can participate and thrive, regardless of background or personal circumstances. This commitment will guide our recruitment process.
Our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion policy is available here.
Questions
If you have any questions, please contact penarthttc@gmail.com.

title: Support
text:
The Penarth Table Tennis Club is a non-profit, unincorporated association. The income we generate through our table tennis activities is entirely used to cover our running costs. Our main expenses include:

Renting the sports hall at St Cyres School. We are charged £40 per hour, which supports the school.
Renewing our equipment, such as tables, nets, balls, and barriers.
Renewing our membership affiliation with Table Tennis Wales.
Training volunteers (safeguarding, first aid, coaching, etc.)

We benefitted from the generous support of the Be Active Wales Fund, funded by the National Lottery and the Welsh Government, who awarded us nearly £3,000 to setup of the club in early 2025 and a further £2,400 in early 2026 to grow the club further through the purchase of new tables.
We set our membership fee at the minimum price to break even. For the club to grow, we rely on the gracious support of our supporters. With sufficient support, we may be able to organise community events and activities for children.
If you would like to make a donation, get in touch to ask for our bank details. We are also open to sponsoring or partnership opportunities. If you would like to contact us about a proposal, see our contact page.

title: About us
text:
Penarth Table Tennis Club is a community club based in Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan. It was established in 2025 by Achille and Antoine. They met in Cardiff but both grew up playing table tennis in France. Across them, they have played in over ten clubs in four different countries. They like nothing more than spreading the joy of a good game of ping-pong.
Penarth Table Tennis Club is:

Open to all adults and motivated children aged 12 and over.
Affiliated with Table Tennis Wales.
Offering opportunities to play leisurely and competitively.
Part of the community.

The club’s constitution can be found here. The Committee is currently made of:

Chair: Achille Versaevel
Secretary: Rhydian Butler-Rees
Social media manager: Susana Galván Hernández

We welcome expressions of interests to volunteer with the club, in a range of capacities.
The club is committed to promoting equity, diversity and inclusion across all aspects of its activities. We aim to provide a welcoming, safe, and supportive environment where everyone can participate, enjoy, and achieve in table tennis, regardless of background or personal circumstances. The club’s Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion policy can be found here.

title: Safeguarding
text:
The Penarth Table Tennis Club is committed to being a safe place. Our safeguarding policy can be found here. It notably includes information about the responsibilities of club officials, how to raise a concern, and how it will be dealt with.
Safeguarding is everyone’s responsibility. Everyone is encouraged to remain vigilant at all times and to report concerns to the club’s Safeguarding Officer. Committee members, volunteers, and parents are encouraged to learn more about safeguarding, for instance by consulting the resources provided by Table Tennis Wales or by taking this free online course.
The club’s Safeguarding Officer is Achille. He attends most sessions run by the club and can be contacted at penarthttc@gmail.com.
St Cyres School Centre has its own safeguarding policy, which can be found here. Table Tennis Wales also has a safeguarding policy, here, as well as a range of safeguarding documents. Its Safeguarding Officer is Wendy, who can be contacted on safeguarding@tabletennis.wales or on 07500046861.
Concerns can also be reported directly via MyVoice, a specialised online system, using this form. Concerns raised via the platform are handled directly by Table Tennis Wales.

title: Contact
text:
We play in the Sports hall of St Cyres School in Penarth: Sully Rd, Penarth CF64 2XP. There is free onsite parking at the school. The school is a 10 minutes’ drive from central Cardiff and well connected to the Vale of Glamorgan including Dinas Powys, Sully, and Barry.


When you arrive at the school, report to reception for directions. Alternatively, go down the stairs immediately in front of you and, once at the bottom, go through the double doors immediately on your left. You will find us at the end of the corridor.
To receive regular updates and reminders about club nights, join our official WhatsApp group by clicking here. It is open to all members and non-members.
For all other inquiries, please email us at penarthttc@gmail.com.
